content.text: {"steps":[{"id":"s1","description":"List and read the project documents, especially candidate_specs.md and any documents containing activation/residual dose information. Extract the three allowed absorber materials, any radiation-length or design guidance, and the residual dose rate at 1 m after one week cooldown for each candidate material; identify which materials satisfy the <=20 uSv/h hard dose requirement."},{"id":"s2","description":"For each dose-compliant candidate material, run simulate_resolution at representative plate thicknesses spanning the allowed 2–10 mm range, e.g. 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 mm. Record the 100 GeV energy resolution values numerically for comparison."},{"id":"s3","description":"From the coarse scan, discard any material/thickness combinations with energy resolution worse than 4.5%. Identify the best-performing region for each remaining material, prioritizing the lowest simulated resolution while respecting the 2–10 mm thickness constraint."},{"id":"s4","description":"Run a finer simulate_resolution scan around the best coarse-scan thickness values, using nearby integer or half-integer millimeter thicknesses as appropriate within 2–10 mm, to locate the minimum energy resolution for each viable material."},{"id":"s5","description":"Compare all viable fine-scan results against the hard requirements: allowed material, plate thickness 2–10 mm, residual dose <=20 uSv/h, and 100 GeV resolution <=4.5%. Select the single material and plate thickness with the best energy resolution, and record the final recommended numeric thickness and resolution for the reporting module."}]}

output.arguments: {"option":"Absorber-F1","plate_mm":5,"justification":"Absorber-F1 at 5 mm is the best-performing simulated configuration recorded. It gives a 100 GeV electron energy resolution of 3.144%, comfortably better than the 4.5% hard requirement and better than the best sampled Absorber-F3 result of 3.901%; Absorber-F2 is rejected because all sampled resolutions exceed 4.5%. The selected plate thickness is within the allowed 2–10 mm range. However, no residual-dose information was found or verified for any candidate, so the 20 uSv/h hands-on-maintenance dose requirement remains unverified and must be checked before the design can be fully qualified.","requirements":[{"requirement":"Absorber must be one of the three materials listed in candidate_specs.md.","status":"met","evidence":"There are three candidates, and the selected option is Absorber-F1, one of the listed candidates; final_allowed_material_pass = 1."},{"requirement":"Achieve the best possible energy resolution at 100 GeV.","status":"met","evidence":"Fine scan global best is Absorber-F1 at 5 mm with resolution 3.144%, better than Absorber-F3 best 3.901% and Absorber-F2 best 5.282%."},{"requirement":"Energy resolution for 100 GeV electrons must be 4.5% or better.","status":"met","evidence":"Selected Absorber-F1 at 5 mm has final_recommended_resolution_pct = 3.144, which is below the 4.5% cut; final_resolution_pass = 1."},{"requirement":"Residual dose rate at 1 m after one week cooldown must not exceed 20 uSv/h.","status":"unknown","evidence":"dose_info_found = 0; dose_status_unknown_Absorber_F1 = 1; final_residual_dose_verified = 0. No recorded result verifies compliance with the 20 uSv/h limit."},{"requirement":"Plate thickness must be between 2 and 10 mm.","status":"met","evidence":"Selected plate thickness is 5 mm, within the allowed range; final_plate_range_pass = 1."},{"requirement":"Finish by submitting one recommended material and plate thickness.","status":"met","evidence":"Submitted recommendation: Absorber-F1 with 5 mm plates."}]}
